name: Vengeance on the Northspring
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...

I was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.

Even now, I can still hear their cries echoing...

I was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.

The Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. adventurer, get my revenge.
narrative.objectives: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. You have put an old tauren's mind at peace.
narrative.requestItemsText: The wings of the Northspring harpies are black as the night; do not take your eyes off of them, lest they disappear into darkness.
